name: Lab08 Lens
description:
Lens is a venture-capital deal-flow and due-diligence platform. This connector puts your Lens workspace in Claude, so you can work a pipeline without switching tabs.

Ask about the companies you are evaluating and Claude answers from your own tenant's data: who leads a deal, which pipeline stage it sits in, what the last outside-in scan concluded, what a founder said in a meeting. Every call is scoped to the tenant behind your credentials - no other tenant can be addressed.

What you can do:

• Browse the pipeline - search and filter companies, read a full company record, see the team and who owns which deal.
• Read the workspace - one tool per section: evidence, observations, outside-in assessment, tech DD overview, tech moat, compliance framework, technology assessment, dependency graph, company context, uploaded files, emails, DMs, meetings, meeting transcripts, founder/team files and user notes. Text-like documents come back with their body inlined.
• Move deals through your deal flow - add a company from a website or a pitch deck, change its pipeline stage, reassign its lead.
• Add/read documents - upload one file or up to 20 at once; approve or reject a finding; link evidence to an observation.
• Run due diligence - start an outside-in scan on a company and poll it to completion.
• Ask the Lens agent - dispatch a question to the per-company agent that reasons over that company's whole workspace, then read its answer. Past chat threads are readable too.

Requires a Lens account. Sign in happens over OAuth against your organization's Lens instance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lab08 Lens to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lab08 Lens to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.lens.lab08.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lab08 Lens MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lab08 Lens lists 36 MCP tools, including chat_with_company, check_company_dd_progress, create_company, get_company, get_company_chat_transcript, get_company_file, get_lens_response, link_evidence, list_companies, list_company_chat_sessions, list_company_compliance_framework, and list_company_context.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lab08 Lens?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lab08 Lens in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Lab08 Lens MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lab08 Lens requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lab08 Lens is developed by Lab08. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
